title: Platform Edge Floating Enemy Continues Horizontal Motion Without Falling
explanation: At frame 1222 (t=21.50s), FloatingEnemy moved off the platform ledge at (7200, 550) and continued horizontal motion in mid-air without falling. Traced to Enemy.gd:L36-L47 where BugFlags.map2_floating_enemy forces velocity.y = 0.0 when not is_on_floor(), suppressing gravity and violating physical kinematics.
